question:
Consider the following statements regarding the revised series of Wholesale Price Index (WPI) and Producer Price Index (PPI) released by the Office of Economic Adviser (DPIIT) in June 2026:

I. The new WPI and PPI series will have the base year 2022-23, replacing the existing 2011-12 base year for WPI.
II. The revised WPI and PPI will be published alongside each other for a dual publication period of 3 years, after which WPI will be discontinued.
III. Service PPIs will be released on a quarterly basis with a 55 days lag from the reference quarter and will cover 7 services including Railways and Air Passenger.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
rationale: Statement II is incorrect because the dual publication period for WPI and PPI is 5 years, not 3 years. After this transition period, WPI will be discontinued, and PPI will become the primary producer-price measure. Statements I and III are correct as per the guidelines. (Refer Page 4, 49)
